description: Create and manage subscriptions for NF instance status/profile change notifications, including same-PLMN and cross-PLMN cases.
normative_statements: The NF Service Consumer shall send a POST request to the resource URI representing the "subscriptions" collection resource.
The request body shall include the data indicating the type of notifications that the NF Service Consumer is interested in receiving.
The request body shall include a callback URI where the NF Service Consumer shall be prepared to receive the actual notification from the NRF.
The request body may include a validity time suggested by the NF Service Consumer.

The subscription shall be authorized or rejected by the NRF by checking the relevant input attributes in the subscription request body, along with any optional OAuth2 access token, against the authorization attributes in the NF Profile of the target NF Instance to be monitored.

Upon receiving a request to subscribe to the complete profile of NF instances, the NRF shall verify that the requesting entity is authorized to subscribe to the complete profile of NF instances, based on local policies or an OAuth2 access token granting such permission.

If the requesting entity is not authorized to subscribe to the complete profile of NF instances, the NRF shall reject the request or handle it as a subscription request without access to the complete profile.

When the subscription request is for a set of NFs, NF Instances in the set that are not authorized for the NF Service Consumer shall not result in triggering any notification event from the NRF to the NF Service Consumer.
On success, the NRF shall return "201 Created".
The response shall contain the data related to the created subscription, including the validity time as determined by the NRF.
If creation fails due to errors in the SubscriptionData JSON object in the request body, the NRF shall return "400 Bad Request" with ProblemDetails providing details of the error.

If verification of the input attributes against the NF Service Consumer certificate is unsuccessful, the request shall be rejected with "400 Bad Request" and the "cause" attribute set to "INVALID_CLIENT".
If creation fails due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return "500 Internal Server Error" with ProblemDetails providing details of the error.
In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return a 3xx status code containing a Location header with a URI pointing to another NRF service instance.

For a subscription to NF Instances in a different PLMN, the POST request sent to the NRF in the Serving PLMN shall include the identity of the PLMN of the home NRF in the SubscriptionData parameter in the request body.
The NRF in Serving PLMN shall send a POST request to the resource URI in the NRF in Home PLMN representing the "subscriptions" collection resource.
The request body sent from the NRF in Serving PLMN to the NRF in Home PLMN shall include the SubscriptionData received from the NF Service Consumer.

If the NRF in Serving PLMN knows that OAuth2-based authorization is required for accessing the NFManagement service of the NRF in Home PLMN and the request does not include an access token, the NRF in Serving PLMN may reject the request with "401 Unauthorized".
On success for a cross-PLMN subscription, the NRF in Serving PLMN shall generate a new subscriptionID and send it to the NF Service Consumer in the Serving PLMN.
If the Home NRF is located in a PLMN, the NRF in Serving PLMN shall send to the NF Service Consumer a subscriptionID of the form <MCC>+<MNC>+"-"+<OriginalSubscriptionID>.
If the Home NRF is located in an SNPN, the NRF in Serving PLMN shall send to the NF Service Consumer a subscriptionID of the form <MCC>+<MNC>+"-"+"x3Lf57A"+":nid="+<NID>+":"+<OriginalSubscriptionID>.
The Location header returned by the NRF in Serving PLMN to the NF Service Consumer shall contain a subscriptionId modified as specified for cross-PLMN subscriptions.
If the Location header contains an absolute URI, its apiRoot shall point to the address of the NRF in Serving PLMN.
The subscriptionId attribute in the response body returned by the NRF in Serving PLMN shall contain the modified subscriptionId.
When an intermediate forwarding NRF identifies the next hop NRF, it shall forward the subscription request to that NRF.
On success in the intermediate forwarding NRF case, NRF-2 shall return "201 Created".
If creation fails in the intermediate forwarding NRF case, NRF-2 shall return a "4XX/5XX" response.
The content of the POST response forwarded by NRF-1 to the NF Service Consumer shall contain the representation describing the status of the request.
The Location header in the POST response forwarded by NRF-1 to the NF Service Consumer shall be present and shall contain the URI of the created resource.
When an intermediate redirecting NRF identifies the next hop NRF, it shall redirect the subscription request by returning HTTP 307 Temporary Redirect.
The 307 Temporary Redirect response shall contain a Location header field whose host part represents NRF-3.
Upon receiving a 307 Temporary Redirect response, NRF-1 shall send the subscription request to NRF-3 by using the URI contained in the Location header field.
On success in the intermediate redirecting NRF case, NRF-3 shall return "201 Created".
If creation fails in the intermediate redirecting NRF case, NRF-3 shall return "4XX/5XX".
On success in the intermediate redirecting NRF case, "201 Created" shall be forwarded to the NF Service Consumer via NRF-1.
On failure in the intermediate redirecting NRF case, "4XX/5XX" shall be forwarded to the NF Service Consumer via NRF-1.
The NF Service Consumer shall send a PATCH request to the resource URI identifying the individual subscription resource when updating a subscription.
The PATCH request shall contain a "replace" operation on the "validityTime" attribute of the SubscriptionData structure.
The PATCH request shall contain a new suggested value for the "validityTime" attribute.
No other attribute of the resource shall be updated as part of the PATCH operation.
If the NRF accepts the requested validityTime value when extending the subscription lifetime, it shall return "204 No Content".
If the NRF accepts the extension of the subscription lifetime but assigns a validity time different from the value suggested by the NF Service Consumer, it shall return "200 OK".
The response to such an update shall contain the new resource representation of the "subscription" resource.
The response representation shall include the new validity time as determined by the NRF.
If update fails due to errors in the JSON Patch object in the request body, the NRF shall return "400 Bad Request" with ProblemDetails providing details of the error.
If update fails due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return "500 Internal Server Error" with ProblemDetails providing details of the error.
For a cross-PLMN subscription update, the PATCH request sent to the NRF in the Serving PLMN shall include the identity of the PLMN or SNPN of the home NRF as component values of the subscriptionID.
The subscriptionID sent to the NRF in the Home PLMN shall not contain the identity of the PLMN.

If the subscription was created in a different NRF in the HPLMN than the NRF in the HPLMN that receives the update request, the latter shall forward the request toward the NRF in the HPLMN holding the subscription using the information included in the subscriptionID.
The subscriptionID value in the request forwarded to the NRF in the HPLMN holding the subscription shall contain the same value as originally generated by that NRF.
The NRF in Serving PLMN shall send a PATCH request to the resource URI representing the individual subscription for cross-PLMN updates.
If the NRF in the Home PLMN accepts the requested validityTime value when extending the subscription lifetime, it shall return "204 No Content".
If the NRF in the Home PLMN accepts the extension of the subscription lifetime but assigns a validity time different from the value suggested by the NF Service Consumer, it shall return "200 OK".
The response to a cross-PLMN update shall contain the new resource representation of the "subscription" resource.
The response representation for a cross-PLMN update shall include the new validity time as determined by the NRF in the Home PLMN.
